purpose: Strengthen naturalistic activation evidence with a bounded chronological restart probe while preserving the Class-A accounting-only scope.

source_bound_restart_capability.final_state_writer: Output_Init.for writes Rsex into >orgexu: of INITIAL.OUT
source_bound_restart_capability.hydrology_subperiod_support: input1.for can position SWATRE.UNF to an ANIMO start date inside the hydrology period

probe_design.segment_A: Run frozen diagnostic CranMais from 1974-01-01 through 1974-12-31 and capture model-produced INITIAL.OUT.
probe_design.segment_B: Restart on 1975-01-01 using segment-A INITIAL.OUT byte-for-byte as INITIAL.INP, unchanged hydrology payload positioned by the legacy reader, and a deterministic execution-copy management tail preserving the original 1975 crop/addition chronology.
probe_design.comparison: Evaluate only the TCD-026 restart-state and beginning-ledger identity surfaces required for Class-A readiness; retain a separate continuous-vs-formatted-restart crosscheck without promoting it to exact checkpoint identity.

continuous_vs_split_crosscheck.interpretation: Legacy formatted restart is not promoted to an exact canonical checkpoint. This limitation is retained rather than hidden by tolerance.

explicit_nonclaims: This probe does not qualify full continuous-vs-split whole-model trajectory identity through legacy formatted INITIAL.OUT/IN.
This probe does not qualify all management continuation semantics generally; it uses a bounded deterministic 1975 execution-copy tail.
This probe does not create B2 historical-reference evidence.
This probe does not constitute independent second-line review.
